purpose: causal diagnosis of reader and execution inefficiencies, not competitor ranking
production_changes: none in this investigation; existing uncommitted direct string grouping remains the baseline

sql.filter_count: select count(*) from read_parquet(?) where id>=0 and active
sql.group_day_sum: select day,sum(id) from read_parquet(?) where id>=262192 group by day order by day asc nulls last
sql.group_sum: select category,sum(id) from read_parquet(?) where id>=262192 group by category order by category asc nulls last
sql.string_filter_sum: select sum(id) from read_parquet(?) where category='north' and score>-23.0

polars.filter_count:
SELECT [len()]
  Parquet SCAN [/tmp/peg-baseline.zZwcQ3/bench.parquet]
  PROJECT 2/9 COLUMNS
  SELECTION: [(col("active")) & ([(col("id")) >= (0)])]
polars.group_day_sum:
SORT BY [nulls_last: [true]] [col("day")]
  AGGREGATE[maintain_order: false]
    [col("id").cast(Int64).sum()] BY [col("day")]
    FROM
    Parquet SCAN [/tmp/peg-baseline.zZwcQ3/bench.parquet]
    PROJECT 2/9 COLUMNS
    SELECTION: [(col("id")) >= (262192)]
polars.group_sum:
SORT BY [nulls_last: [true]] [col("category")]
  AGGREGATE[maintain_order: false]
    [col("id").cast(Int64).sum()] BY [col("category")]
    FROM
    Parquet SCAN [/tmp/peg-baseline.zZwcQ3/bench.parquet]
    PROJECT 2/9 COLUMNS
    SELECTION: [(col("id")) >= (262192)]
polars.string_filter_sum:
SELECT [col("id").cast(Int64).sum()]
  Parquet SCAN [/tmp/peg-baseline.zZwcQ3/bench.parquet]
  PROJECT 3/9 COLUMNS
  SELECTION: [([(col("score")) > (-23.0)]) & ([(col("category")) == ("north")])]

word_unpack_experiment.script:
import os,json,subprocess,pathlib,statistics
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/peg-gap-diagnosis')
reports=[]
for round in range(2):
 for query in ('group_day_sum','group_sum','string_filter_sum','filter_count'):
  for mode in (('baseline','word') if round==0 else ('word','baseline')):
   binary=root/('peg' if mode=='baseline' else 'word-peg')
   args=[str(binary),'-parquet','/tmp/peg-baseline.zZwcQ3/bench.parquet','-rows','1048768','-only',query,'-workers','1','-runs','21','-warmup','8']
   report=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,env={**os.environ,'GOMAXPROCS':'1'}))
   reports.append(dict(round=round,query=query,mode=mode,report=report))
   print(round,query,mode,round if False else round,statistics.median(report['queries'][0]['exec_ns'])/1e6,flush=True)
for query in ('group_day_sum','group_sum','string_filter_sum','filter_count'):
 before=[x for r in reports if r['query']==query and r['mode']=='baseline' for x in r['report']['queries'][0]['exec_ns']]
 after=[x for r in reports if r['query']==query and r['mode']=='word' for x in r['report']['queries'][0]['exec_ns']]
 rows=[r['report']['queries'][0]['rows'] for r in reports if r['query']==query]
 assert all(row==rows[0] for row in rows)
 print('SUMMARY',query,statistics.median(before)/1e6,statistics.median(after)/1e6,statistics.median(before)/statistics.median(after),flush=True)
(root/'word-unpack-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2))

dense_fused_experiment.limits: all-valid INT32 ID/date columns and dense 367-date domain checked outside timing; combines filter and direct-index SUM; omits general null/page/selection/type dispatch and output creation; demonstrates opportunity, not a general production speedup
